definitions.day: UTC calendar day of the token event / commit author date
definitions.codexTotal: input (includes cached) + output (includes reasoning), from cumulative total_token_usage deltas per thread
definitions.claudeTotal: input + cache_creation + cache_read + output, per unique message.id
definitions.roles: codex: coordinator = interactive TUI thread on the ops box, worker = codex exec, subagent = spawned by a thread, interactive = laptop TUI; claude: main / subagent
definitions.peakConcurrent: max distinct threads that used tokens in one 10-minute UTC bucket of the day
